correctness.rationale: For nonzero y, the exact bijection x <-> r=N(x) satisfying \(R^2+(\operatorname{Tr}(a)-N(y))R+N(a)=0\) is proved in both directions. The exceptional y=0 norm fiber is identified. For odd q, irreducibility of a outside K ensures nonsquare D(0), and standard quadratic-character sums give exact zero/one/two root counts; for even q, absolute-trace criteria count the corresponding fibers, including the single inseparable discriminant value. The coefficient class cardinalities and bijection exceptions follow. A standalone direct enumeration confirms all spectral formulas in 14 small fields (173 coefficient cases, 70,549 inputs), not a replacement for proof.

value.rationale: The natural finite-field inverse/Frobenius map has highly parameter-dependent fiber sizes. The theorem classifies every coefficient, every target multiplicity, exact image size and tiny-field permutation exceptions over all prime powers, including the norm-square dichotomy invisible from the base-field case. The result is a complete motivated structural classification rather than an arbitrary finite slice or merely a restatement of the existing base-parameter value-set bound.
